name: chapter-list
title: Chapter list
description: The chapters of a video or podcast as timestamps: the playing one marked with a rail and a progress line, click to seek, each length shown.
docs: Pass chapters ({ start, title }, start in seconds), currentTime and onSeek; duration gives the last chapter an end and a length. Ends and lengths are worked out from the next start, so you only keep starts. The chapter that holds currentTime gets aria-current, a thin rail, a heavier title, a line that fills as the chapter goes by and "Now playing" for screen readers. Every row is a button read as one phrase ("04:12, Pricing, 3 minutes") that calls onSeek(start). Tab enters the list once, on the playing chapter; the arrow keys, Home and End walk it. The list moves itself to the playing chapter, never the page, and jumps without animation under reduced motion. It does not own the media element, so it works with a video, an audio element or an embed. maxHeight sets where it scrolls, locale writes the lengths, labels translates the fixed words.
